title: Toolkit report document
description: The JSON document a headless run of the toolkit writes (-Report, -CompareWith), format 1.x. docs/REPORT-FORMAT.md is the reference; this schema checks the envelope and each report's wrapper, not the Data of each report.

Schema.description: What the document is: always toolkit-report.

SchemaVersion.description: major.minor. A minor version only adds fields.

Computer.description: The computer name, or PC-1 when the document is pseudonymised.

MachineId.description: 32 hexadecimal characters derived from the Windows MachineGuid, the same with or without -Redact and after a rename; empty when it cannot be read.

User.description: The account that ran the collection, as DOMAIN\user.

GeneratedAt.description: When the document was made, ISO 8601 with the offset.

Toolkit.description: The build that wrote the document.

Elevated.description: Whether the run had administrator rights. A report that needs them is Skipped otherwise.

Privacy.description: The -Redact level the document was pseudonymised at.

Summary.description: What a monitoring rule reads without knowing the shape of each report.

Reports.description: One entry per report collected, by name, in the order asked.

Comparison.description: Only with -CompareWith: what changed since the document given.

judgement.description: The worst judgement found; empty when nothing is judged.

Version.description: The version of this report's Data: it rises when one of its fields is removed, renamed or changes type or meaning.

Reason.description: Why the report was skipped or failed; empty when it is Ok.

Data.description: The report as the interface shows it; null when it is not Ok. docs/REPORT-FORMAT.md lists what each one holds.
